# anthropic_user (Data Source)

Looks up a single organization member by `id` or `email` (`/v1/organizations/users`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the user. Exactly one of `id` or `email` must be set.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user (`user_...`). Exactly one of `id` or `email` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the user joined the organization.
- `name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `role` (String) Organization-level role of the user.
- `type` (String) Object type (`user`).
